paite: Huan Elisha in atapa ahihdamsak numei kiang ah, “Thou inla, nang leh na inkote na omtheihna munmun uah va kialtai tadih un. TOUPA'N lah kial akesak ngal a, hiai gam ah kum sagih sung kial ake ding," achi hi.
heading: Shunem Numei Ahong Kik

paite: Huchi in numei athou a, Pathian mipa thugen bang in ahih a; a-inkote toh Philistiate gam ah kum sagih ava kialtai uhi.
Kum sagih ahong kivei nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei Philistiate gam a pan akik nawn a; a-inn leh alou ngen ding in kumpipa azuan hi.
Kumpipa'n Pathian mipa sikha Gehazi ahoupih a, "Elisha in thil thupi ahih tengteng hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.

Asisa mi khat ahinsak nawn thu kumpipa ana hilh laitak in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, atapa ahinsak nawn numei in a-inn leh alou kumpipa kiang ah ahong ngen hi. Gehazi in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, hiai numei ahi, hiai ahi atapa, Elisha in ahinsak nawn,” achi hi.
Kumpipa'n numei adotleh ahilh hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n heutu khat asehsak a, "Amah a tengteng, alou a thil piang tengteng tan in, hiai gam apawtkhiaksan a pan tuni tan ateng pe nawn vek un,” achi hi.
Damaskas ah Elisha ahoh a; Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad achi ana hi. "Pathian mipa hiai ah ahong ve," chi in ahilh uh.
heading: Elisha Leh Siria Kumpipa Ben-hadad

paite: Kumpipa'n Hazael kiang ah, "Thilpiak tawi inla, Pathian mipa houpih ding in va hoh inla, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn thei diam, TOUPA hon na dotsakleh," achi hi.

Amah houpih ding in Hazael akuan a, thilpiak ding Damaskas a thil hoih chiteng, sangawngsau sawmli puak khop atawi a, ama ah ava dingh a, "Na tapa Ben-hadad, Siria kumpipa in, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn diam chi ding in na kiang ah kei ahon sawl hi,” achi hi.
Elisha in akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, akiang ah, na hoihkhe nawn na mah ke, achi ve, va chi in. Himahleh ataktak in bel asi ngeingei ding chih, TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi," achi hi.
Huchi in amah a dia zumhuai khop in Elisha in a-ensal gegu a; huchi in Pathian mipa akapta hi.

Hazael in, "Bangziak a ka toupa kap ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Israel suante tung a na thil hoih lou hih ding ka theih ziak in ahi. Akulhte uh na hal dia, atangvalte uh namsau in na that dia, atanu neu chikchikte na paizan dia, naupai lai anumeite uh na pikkek ding," achi hi.
Hazael in, "Kei na sikha ui leltak in hiai thil thupi hihthei ding ka hi mahmah a hia?" achi hi. Elisha in adawng a, "Siriate tung ah na hong lal ding chih TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi " achi hi.
Huchi in Elisha kiang a pan apawt a, apu kiang ah apaita hi. Ama'n, “Elisha in bang hon na hilh a?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hoihkhe nawn na tham ding, chi in ahon hilh," achi hi.
Azing in hichi ahong hi a, puansahpi khat ala a, tui ah adiah a, amai akhuhsak a, huchi in asita a; asik in Hazael alalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram kum nga alal kum in huai lai in Jehoshaphat bel Judah kumpipa ahi, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoramod

paite: Alal pat lai in kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
Ahab inkote bang in, Israel kumpipate lampi tot atawn a; Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N asikha David ziak in Judah gam ahihse nuam kei a, asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak gige ana chiam tak ziak in.
Adam lai in Judahte tung ah Edomte ahel ua, atung ua kumpipa ding akibawltawm uhi.
Huchi in Zair ah kangtalai tengteng toh Joram ahoh hi. Zan in akisakhia a, amau um Edomte leh akangtalai tung ua heutute ava sualta hi. Huchi in mite apuaninte uah atai uhi.
Edomte tuni tan in Judahte tung ah ahel lailai uh. Huai hun mah in Libnah leng ana hel sam uhi.
Jehoram tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah akigelh kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoram api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaziah alalta hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram lal akum sawm-le-nih kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah / (2 Kro 22.1-6)

paite: Ahaziah in vai ahawm pat in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm hi. Anu min Athaliah ahi a, amah Israel kumpipa Omri tanu ahi.
Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn sam a, Ahab inkote makpapa ahih ziak in, Ahab inkote hih bang in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
Amah Ahab tapa Joram in Ramoth-gilead a Siria kumpipa Hazael ava douna ah apang sam hi. Siriate'n Joram ana hihliam uhi.

Siria kumpipa Hazael adouna uah Siriate'n Ramah ah kumpipa Joram ana hihliam ua, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawnta hi. Ahab tapa Joram adam louh ziak in, amah veh ding in Jezreel ah Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah ahohsuk hi.
